summary: Verified the Tata Smartflo click-to-call fix end-to-end. Backend: added /app/backend/tests/test_smartflo.py (20 pytest cases, all PASSED) covering .env sanitisation (no 'os.environ.get' text, JWT-shaped token, ADMIN_EMAIL=butbrucewill@gmail.com), GET /api/calls/diagnostics healthy path + agent-equals-DID detection + 401, POST /api/calls/click-to-call validation paths (401 unauth, 400 short/empty destination, 400 no agent number with helper text), TWO live successful click-to-call invocations to Tata (destinations '+91 98100 12301' and via lead) that returned HTTP 200 success:true with real call_id (e.g. HYD1-D10-1789195615.788272 / DR4-D1-1789195734.1067519), audit trail persisted in mongo.call_attempts with normalised agent_number=919812345678 and destination_number=919810012301, and the lead's activity log contains a 'call_initiated' entry. Backend server log confirms 'smartflo click_to_call status=200 agent=919812345678 dest=919810012301 response={success:True,...}'. Owner admin butbrucewill@gmail.com and legacy admin@crm.com both log in as role=admin; all 6 seeded demo users also log in. Full regression: 71 pre-existing pytest cases (backend_test.py + test_export_tz.py) still PASS. Grand total 91/91 backend pytest cases GREEN. Frontend: verified owner admin can open Dialer page (data-testid=dialer-page), Users page Add-user dialog shows EMPTY agent-number field (data-testid=new-user-agent-number) with helper text 'Do not enter the company DID/caller ID here', 11 row-level user-agent-number-<id> inline inputs render, and caller1 (no agent number) posting to /dialer produces the exact 400 error toast 'No Smartflo agent number set for your account. An admin can add it on the Users page (Agent # column).' - not a generic failure. Kept live paid Smartflo calls to 2 (both from the backend test module) as requested.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~1101 lines - still growing (chat/documents/CRM activities added by the user). Split into routers before the next feature.

smartflo_number() silently returns the raw digit string when length != 10 (e.g. '123' becomes '123'). The len(destination_number) < 10 guard in click_to_call catches this, but diagnostics.agent_number_sent_as could still expose a malformed value to the UI. Consider normalising to None or raising for non-10-digit input.

click_to_call catches httpx.RequestError but does NOT persist a call_attempts document when the network layer fails - only successful (or Smartflo-rejected) attempts are audited. Move the insert_one before the raise so ops can see transport failures too.
Known pre-existing (out of scope, reported to main agent): document uploads write to pod-local backend/uploads/documents rather than object storage - not durable in Kubernetes.
call_attempts collection has no TTL/index on created_at; will grow unbounded. Add an index and a retention policy.

success_rate.backend: 100% (91/91 pytest cases; 20 new smartflo + 71 existing regression)
success_rate.frontend: 100% of tested flows (owner admin login, Dialer page loads, Users add-user dialog agent-number empty default + helper text, row-level inline agent input present, caller1 no-agent 400 error toast)

test_credentials: /app/memory/test_credentials.md is accurate; owner admin butbrucewill@gmail.com/admin123, legacy admin@crm.com/admin123, plus 6 seeded pass123 accounts all log in.
seed_data_creation: No new leads or users seeded. Live click-to-call attempts wrote 2 documents into mongo.call_attempts which are cleaned up by test_smartflo.teardown_module (delete_many where created_at within last 30 minutes). Owner admin's agent_number was set to '9812345678' during the test and left in that state (matches task requirement).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Smartflo tests live in /app/backend/tests/test_smartflo.py and hit the LIVE Tata paid API - each run of test_click_to_call_success_response places a real originate. To skip: `pytest -k 'not live_call_result and not click_to_call_success_response and not persists_audit and not writes_lead_activity'`. The current SMARTFLO_API_TOKEN in backend/.env is a JWT valid till exp=1796887856 (Jan 2027). If a future test agent needs to reset owner admin's agent_number, PATCH /api/users/{id} with {agent_number:'9812345678'}. Frontend testids: dialer-page, dialer-phone, direct-dial-button, dialer-lead-name, add-lead-dial-button, new-user-agent-number, user-agent-number-<id>, lead-direct-call-button.
rca_of_the_issue: Original bug (from user's own edits): backend/.env contained literal Python code as values, e.g. `SMARTFLO_API_TOKEN = os.environ.get("eyJ...")`. dotenv preserved the whole RHS verbatim, so the backend sent `Authorization: Bearer os.environ.get("eyJ...")` and Tata returned {success:false,message:'Deleted or blacklisted token provided'}. Fix (main agent) rewrote .env to plain KEY="value" lines, added smartflo_number() E.164->91XXXXXXXXXX normaliser, a /calls/diagnostics endpoint that flags 'contains Python code' / missing token / missing agent / agent==DID, made click_to_call reject before dial when agent_number is unset (HTTP 400 with actionable message) and surface Tata's own error message (HTTP 502), and stopped defaulting the Add-User agent field to the company DID. Verified by placing a real call: status_code=200, success=true, call_id=HYD1-D10-1789195615.788272.
